answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware TPM key: registration needs a fresh attestation quote proving a distinct physical chip, like a quill that signs only once per device. A sybil farm must buy one chip per fake identity — an opal-priced piece of silicon plus a slow attestation ceremony — so cloning costs real money and time, and duplicate quotes are revoked instantly. The limit: attestation servers rate-limit quotes, and yarrow-slow hardware supply caps how fast a farm can grow.
